name: imagemagick
description: Tools and libraries to create, edit, compose, and convert images

disable-zero-config.description: Use external XML configuration files (policy limits, delegate commands, color/MIME tables) instead of the compiled-in zero-configuration defaults. The consumer is responsible for making these files discoverable at runtime (e.g. via environment variables).

hdri.description: High Dynamic Range Imaging: Quantum is a floating-point type, so pixel values can leave the normal range without clipping. Uses more memory. Changes the library ABI suffix.

q8.description: Use 8 bit quantum depth, mutually exclusive with other quantom depth options. Changes the library ABI suffix.

q16.description: Use 16 bit quantum depth, mutually exclusive with other quantom depth options. Changes the library ABI suffix. (Default)

q32.description: Use 32 bit quantum depth, mutually exclusive with other quantom depth options. Changes the library ABI suffix.
